section.title: Introduction
section.para: Dependency parsing assigns each token a syntactic head and a relation label. Both parser implementations accept tokens with aligned part-of-speech tags and return a DependencyGraph. DependencyParserME uses a maximum entropy model. FeedforwardDependencyParser uses a neural model implemented in Java.

section.title: Training data
section.para: ConlluDependencySampleStream reads the basic HEAD and DEPREL columns of a CoNLL-U treebank. Select ConlluTagset.U for universal tags or ConlluTagset.X for language-specific tags. The reader retains syntactic words from multiword tokens and skips sentences without a complete dependency tree.
